motivation: v2 found durable convergence-state information in gold/silver residual dislocations but static rolling-window equilibrium produced sparse/asymmetric executable returns. v3 changes the mechanism to a recursive adaptive equilibrium. Signals are one-step innovations relative to the prior model, exits use the live adaptive innovation, and the entry hedge remains frozen. No v2 threshold is relaxed or rescued.

source.instrument_semantics: independent MT5-style cash XAUUSD and XAGUSD daily bars

retrospective_extension.claim_boundary: Retrospective only; related gold/silver evidence from this era has already been inspected.

adaptive_model.type: recursive least squares on log(gold_close) = alpha + beta * log(silver_close)
adaptive_model.innovation_variance_update: lambda * old_variance + (1-lambda) * innovation^2 after each observation
adaptive_model.prediction_semantics: innovation at close t is computed from the model fitted only through t-1; model update occurs after recording the t innovation

signal_grid.direction: mean reversion: positive innovation => short gold/long silver; negative innovation => long gold/short silver

hedge.method: pre-update recursive beta at signal time

execution.exit: after minimum hold, first completed close whose live adaptive innovation satisfies the exit band; fill next common open; otherwise next common open after max hold

state_first.predictor: absolute one-step innovation z-score at signal close
state_first.target: -sign(entry_innovation_z) * (frozen-entry-model residual at t+21 - entry innovation) / entry innovation standard deviation; positive means price convergence relative to the entry-time equilibrium

neighborhood_gate.definition: same family; differs in exactly one adjacent value among forgetting factor, entry threshold, or max hold

ranking: higher primary positive economic fold fraction
higher primary median fold net bps
